notes.title: Announcement Trailer and Demo Release!
notes.content:
We are so proud to announce the demo of our new game: Cards and Dungeons!

[previewyoutube=QOlq12BdUJQ;full][/previewyoutube]

Cards and Dungeons is an action-packed roguelike dungeon crawler blending hack-and-slash gameplay with cards. Fight through procedurally generated floors teeming with monsters, gather loot, and unleash powerful effects with collectible cards. Will you survive the depths?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45340074/0b7b7b14a915a33cc9ca94ce0c4cb6bf3ea2af27.png[/img]

This demo is a sneak peak of Cards and Dungeons, to show you how gameplay works, main mechanic and art of our game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45340074/9708b87534046448d8f6356248e9c52abda7188b.png[/img]

Play the demo and add the game to your wishlist to support the development of the game!

Family Devs.
